experiment: V: full-size native real-data fixed-target comparisons

gdsc.parameters: Historical c=1, same audited cells, genes and split; all preprocessing refitted on training only.

year.parameters: Historical validation-selected c retained: Ridge 1e-6, LW/Showalter/HBF .001, Nesterov/SOAR 1e-5. No new tuning or independent-validation claim.

step_policy: L=32||A_complete||_infinity, h=.9/L frozen before sampling, k_LW=ceil(1/(alpha*h)), k_Nes=max(1,ceil((-3+sqrt(1+24/(alpha*h)))/2)). This changes the old spectral protocol's tiny atom-bound step. L is NOT a support-wide sampled stability bound. Every draw checks L I-M by Cholesky only as a diagnostic; parameters are never adapted. All outputs and any nonfinite failure are retained. No universal finite-moment or stability claim.
continuous_policy: Showalter T=1/alpha, RK4 maxdt=.9/L; HBF eta=2sqrt(alpha), T=u/eta with u-1+exp(-u)=4, maxdt=.2/max(sqrt(L),eta); SOAR s=.5, T=sqrt(6/alpha), w''+Mw=t*c from zero, maxdt=.2/sqrt(L). Integer grid reaches T exactly. Finite-grid target, derivative and OPT match.
implementation: Householder orthogonal tridiagonal coordinates, every recurrence/RK4 stage executed, float64 no fastmath. Blocked reverse algorithmic differentiation of the same native update; no eigen/SVD/analytic-filter output or sensitivity. Ridge direct SPD solve.
probability_policy: UNI, NORM and pivoted-QR leverage with .01 uniform floor; standardized GDSC NORM exactly UNI. OPT minimizes the first-order full coefficient covariance with pi>=.01/N, using complete training data and response and the native discrete derivative. No ridge substitution. Same uniforms pair all methods/rules per budget/rep, budgets independent.
row_policy: Both Gram and response cross-product jointly inverse-probability weighted. Row state is beta. Column state is u and coefficients are full X^T u, not restricted-feature fit.
metrics: response test MSE and mean individual RMSE
first-order coefficient-MSE constant and empirical/theory calibration
statistics: Conditional pointwise Student t29/t49 Monte Carlo intervals; prespecified paired OPT-minus-UNI/NORM/LEV at r=749 GDSC and r=5000 Year, Holm across all 36 method/rule comparisons. Heavy tails, failures and low coverage never trimmed. Not independent data replication; previous test exploration disclosed. No true-beta risk available for real data.
preservation: Do not rerun I-IV. Keep all previous archives, original 1024/1024_journal and theoretical/proof sections unchanged. Update sole fixed exp1 draft after backup. Source-only package is distinct from the full numerical/data archive.
